{{Top|leg}}
'''Comptroller''' was a title that was sometimes held by the leader of a [[City/Legends|city]] or facility.

==History==
During the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Nestin Thokor]] served as the comptroller of the city [[Oluna Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]].<ref name="NPLH">{{LivingForce|No Place Like Home}}</ref> Later, during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Human [[Garnak Fey]] served as the comptroller of the [[Silica Tab]] production lines on the planet [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]].<ref name="FOC">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>
